question: Which of the following states of India will host the 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India__ hosted the 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup from the 13th to the 29th of January 2023.
 
• India hosted this tournament for the fourth time in history.
 
• The world cup is conducted once every four years.
 
• Spain and the Netherlands were named as the co-hosts of the 2022 Women's World Cup scheduled to be held from the 1st to the 22nd of July 2022.
 
• The decisions were made during FIH's Executive Board Meeting in Lausanne, Switzerland on 9 Nov 2019. 
 
• Odisha hosted the 2023 Men's Hockey World Cup from the 13th to the 29th of January 2023.
 
• For the first time, a country in the same city would be hosting successive editions of the premier tournament in the sport making it even more special.
 
• This time, Bhubaneswar which hosted the 2018 WC would share hosting rights with the Biju Patnaik Hockey Stadium in Rourkela.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
